area.title: Predictions
area.blurb: The essential rules for future predictions: forms, certainty, word order and present evidence.

topic.name: Predictions
topic.form: It will rain. / It might rain. / It is going to rain.
topic.formula: will / may / might / could + V1 · be going to + V1 · be likely / bound / certain to + V1
topic.affirmative: It will rain. · It might rain. · It is going to rain.
topic.negative: It won't rain. · It might not rain. · It isn't going to rain.
topic.question: Will it rain? · Do you think it will rain? · Is it going to rain?

note.en: A prediction says what we expect. It is not a plan, an arrangement or a timetable. There is no extra tense called Predictions.
note.ru: Предсказание говорит, чего мы ждем. Это не план, не договоренность и не расписание. Отдельного времени Predictions нет.

usage.en: Choose the form by how sure you are and by whether you can point to evidence now.
usage.ru: Форму выбирают по степени уверенности и по тому, есть ли признак сейчас.

body.en: A prediction answers: what do you expect to happen? Keep it separate from a plan already made, a named arrangement, or a timetable.
body.ru: Предсказание отвечает: чего вы ждете? Его не путают с уже принятым планом, названной договоренностью или расписанием.

en: Look at the sky. It is going to rain.
ru: Look at the sky. It is going to rain.

en: I am going to start a course in June.
ru: I am going to start a course in June.

en: I am meeting Anna at six.
ru: I am meeting Anna at six.

body.en: After will, may, might and could use the base verb: no -s, no to. be going to and be likely to keep be.
body.ru: После will, may, might и could — первая форма: без -s и без to. В be going to и be likely to глагол be обязателен.

en: Do you think it might rain?
ru: Do you think it might rain?

body.en: This is a useful scale, not a percentage. Intonation can make might sound stronger or weaker. will and be going to often overlap.
body.ru: Это полезная шкала, не проценты. Интонация может сделать might сильнее или слабее. will и be going to часто пересекаются.

en: will definitely / certainly · be bound / certain / sure to
The station will definitely be crowded. She is bound to be tired.
ru: will definitely / certainly · be bound / certain / sure to
The station will definitely be crowded. She is bound to be tired.

en: The bus will probably arrive soon. The museum is likely to be busy.
ru: The bus will probably arrive soon. The museum is likely to be busy.

en: will · I think / I'm sure + will
I think electric buses will become more common.
ru: will · I think / I'm sure + will
I think electric buses will become more common.

en: may / might / could · maybe / perhaps + will
We might get tickets. Maybe the next lesson will be shorter.
ru: may / might / could · maybe / perhaps + will
We might get tickets. Maybe the next lesson will be shorter.

en: Some students might not arrive on time.
ru: Some students might not arrive on time.

en: won't · probably won't · definitely won't · be unlikely to
I don't think this shop will close early. The delay is unlikely to last long.
ru: won't · probably won't · definitely won't · be unlikely to
I don't think this shop will close early. The delay is unlikely to last long.

body.en: One modal only. Opinion verbs usually take I don't think + will. maybe / perhaps start the sentence.
body.ru: Только один модальный. При глаголах мнения обычно I don't think + will. maybe / perhaps стоят в начале.

en: The bus will probably arrive soon.
The bus probably will arrive soon.
ru: The bus will probably arrive soon.
The bus probably will arrive soon.

en: It probably won't rain. It definitely won't be quiet.
ru: It probably won't rain. It definitely won't be quiet.

en: It will probably not arrive before six.
ru: It will probably not arrive before six.

en: Maybe the bus will be late.
ru: Maybe the bus will be late.

en: I don't think this shop will close early.
ru: I don't think this shop will close early.

en: Maybe it will rain. / It may be cold.
ru: Maybe it will rain. / It may be cold.

body.en: Name what you can see, hear or know now, then the result. will can still name the same future; going to points to the evidence.
body.ru: Сначала то, что видно, слышно или известно сейчас, затем исход. will может назвать то же будущее; going to указывает на признак.

examples.en: Look at that glass near the edge. It is going to fall.
examples.ru: Смотри, стакан у самого края. Сейчас упадет.

examples.en: The sky is getting very dark. Is it going to rain?
examples.ru: Небо сильно темнеет. Сейчас пойдет дождь?

examples.en: Those bags look heavy. She is going to need help.
examples.ru: Сумки выглядят тяжелыми. Ей понадобится помощь.

examples.en: It isn't going to be a short walk in this heat.
examples.ru: В такую жару прогулка короткой не будет.

body.en: be + adjective + to + base verb. Do not put will in front. It is likely that + clause is also possible.
body.ru: be + прилагательное + to + первая форма. will перед ними не ставят. Также бывает It is likely that + придаточное.

examples.en: The museum is likely to be busy on Sunday.
examples.ru: В воскресенье музей, скорее всего, будет заполнен.

examples.en: The delay is unlikely to last more than an hour.
examples.ru: Задержка вряд ли продлится больше часа.

examples.en: After three hours of classes she is certain to be tired.
examples.ru: После трех часов занятий она точно будет уставшей.

examples.en: The park is bound to be popular when the weather improves.
examples.ru: Когда погода станет лучше, парк точно будет популярным.

examples.en: There is a good chance that the shop will still have tickets.
examples.ru: Есть хороший шанс, что в магазине еще будут билеты.

examples.en: There is no way that the train will leave before we arrive.
examples.ru: Не может быть, чтобы поезд ушел до нашего прихода.

cases.en: Subject + will / won't + base verb. Same form for every subject. I think the shop will close at six. She won't be late.
cases.ru: Подлежащее + will / won't + первая форма. Одна форма для всех лиц. I think the shop will close at six. She won't be late.

cases.en: Will + subject + V1? To ask for an opinion: Do you think + subject + will + V1?
cases.ru: Will + подлежащее + V1? Вопрос о мнении: Do you think + подлежащее + will + V1?

cases.en: Possible but not sure. may well / might well / could well sound more likely. For a possible no, use may not / might not, not couldn't.
cases.ru: Возможно, но не точно. may well / might well / could well звучат вероятнее. Для возможного «нет» — may not / might not, не couldn't.

mistakes.en: Keep one modal: it might rain, not it will might rain. No -s or to after will / may / might / could. Will it rain?, not Does it will rain? Keep be: it is going to rain; it is likely to rain. Maybe is one word. may be is modal + verb. In short negatives put probably / definitely before won't.
mistakes.ru: Один модальный: it might rain, не it will might rain. После will / may / might / could нет -s и нет to. Will it rain?, не Does it will rain? be обязателен: it is going to rain; it is likely to rain. Maybe — одно слово. may be — модальный + глагол. В коротком отрицании probably / definitely стоят перед won't.

differs.en: will often presents a belief. be going to often points to evidence now. Neither form has a fixed percent. may, might and could all leave the future open. A plan is usually be going to or Present Continuous. An arrangement is Present Continuous. A timetable is Present Simple.
differs.ru: will часто подает мнение. be going to чаще ведет к признаку сейчас. Фиксированного процента нет. may, might и could оставляют будущее открытым. План обычно be going to или Present Continuous. Договоренность — Present Continuous. Расписание — Present Simple.

examples.en: I think electric buses will become more common in this city.
examples.ru: Я думаю, электробусы в этом городе станут обычнее.

examples.en: I don't think this shop will close early today.
examples.ru: Не думаю, что этот магазин сегодня закроется рано.

examples.en: The station will definitely be crowded tomorrow morning.
examples.ru: Завтра утром на станции точно будет тесно.

examples.en: It definitely won't be quiet during the festival.
examples.ru: Во время фестиваля точно не будет тихо.

examples.en: Our teacher will probably give us a short quiz.
examples.ru: Учитель, вероятно, даст нам короткий тест.

examples.en: The quiz probably won't take more than ten minutes.
examples.ru: Тест, вероятно, не займет больше десяти минут.

examples.en: Maybe the next lesson will be shorter.
examples.ru: Может, следующий урок будет короче.

examples.en: We may have a lesson outside if the weather stays warm.
examples.ru: Возможно, урок будет на улице, если погода останется теплой.

examples.en: Some students might not arrive on time because of the traffic.
examples.ru: Некоторые студенты могут не успеть из-за пробок.

examples.en: The new timetable could make the journey faster.
examples.ru: Новое расписание могло бы сделать дорогу быстрее.

examples.en: I'm sure the next bus will stop here.
examples.ru: Я уверен, что следующий автобус здесь остановится.

examples.en: I doubt they will find an empty table at eight.
examples.ru: Сомневаюсь, что в восемь они найдут пустой столик.

examples.en: It may well be cold on the platform, so take a coat.
examples.ru: На платформе вполне может быть холодно, так что возьми пальто.
